item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-ca66f696c1f0247f","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"Xi Jinping stated that China would implement the overall strategy for resolving the Taiwan issue, oppose external interference and Taiwan independence, and steadily advance national reunification; he also linked Hong Kong and Macao policy to maintaining long-term prosperity and stability and instructed officials to support economic development and livelihood improvement there.","question_ids":["2B.2","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The statement is attributed directly to Xi Jinping in an Xinhua report.","limitations":["The source records stated policy and objectives, not their implementation or outcomes.","The language on Taiwan includes coercive opposition to independence and external involvement but does not specify operational measures."]},{"source_id":"SRC-74d1583bd7c61483","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"Safeguard Defenders reported that China had added five laws authorizing exit bans over the preceding five years and that exit bans were used to silence activists, pressure family members to force fugitives to return, and intimidate foreign journalists.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report was published in 2023 and describes developments during the preceding five years, including the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The report concerns Chinese state and Party practice under Xi Jinping; it does not identify a specific personal order by Xi.","limitations":["This is an external advocacy organization's finding rather than an official court or audit finding.","The supplied extract does not provide case-level counts or identify which laws were enacted in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3744ccfbc60885f","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"During a phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, Xi Jinping said China's core position on the Ukraine crisis was to promote peace through talks.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The statement is attributed directly to Xi Jinping by Xinhua and the Chinese government website.","limitations":["The source records rhetoric and does not establish whether China achieved a ceasefire or settlement.","The statement does not address China's conduct toward Russia or other dimensions of the war."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c89324830c257685","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"China's Ministry of Public Security reported that, during a 100-day nationwide campaign beginning 10 April 2023, police investigated more than 2,300 cases, addressed internet-platform violations approximately 8,000 times, shut more than 21,000 accounts, and removed more than 705,000 alleged online-rumor items.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.9","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The measures were reported as actions by nationwide public-security organs under the central government system; the extract does not identify a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The official report characterizes the content as rumors and unlawful information; it does not provide independent verification of the classifications.","The extract does not distinguish protection from misinformation from suppression of legitimate criticism."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c8f01286290604a3","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"Xi Jinping told Zelensky that China had issued a 12-point position paper on political resolution of the Ukraine crisis, opposed nuclear war and urged restraint on nuclear issues, said China would send a special representative to Ukraine and other countries for consultations, and said China had provided multiple rounds of humanitarian assistance and would continue helping.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.8","2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The measures and statements are attributed directly to Xi Jinping in the Xinhua account of his call.","limitations":["The source documents announced diplomatic and humanitarian steps, not their later effectiveness.","It does not independently assess the neutrality or consequences of China's position paper."]},{"source_id":"SRC-29c595c9ae1df478","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Xi Jinping instructed China's political-legal system to uphold the Communist Party's absolute leadership, prioritize political security and social stability, promote social fairness and justice, and protect people's safety; the associated national political-legal work conference reiterated implementation of these instructions.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The instructions are attributed directly to Xi Jinping and were transmitted at a national political-legal work conference.","limitations":["The extract states priorities and organizational direction but supplies no outcome data or independent assessment of fairness, justice, or safety.","The emphasis on absolute Party leadership is relevant to institutional independence but does not by itself establish a specific judicial intervention."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8de29b120e5d646e","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"China's February 2023 position paper on the Ukraine crisis called for respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, a ceasefire, negotiations, humanitarian access, civilian and prisoner protection, and reduced strategic risk; it stated that nuclear weapons must not be used or threatened, called for preventing nuclear proliferation and nuclear crises, opposed attacks on nuclear facilities, and rejected biological weapons.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.5","1B.8","2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The document was issued by China's Foreign Ministry as a formal policy position associated with Xi's government.","limitations":["The source establishes a formal position but not compliance by China or the belligerents.","The paper's provisions and implementation mechanisms are not independently evaluated in the supplied extract."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8045b35569f4f1aa","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"China's 2023 Government Work Report set a target of approximately 5 percent economic growth and approximately 12 million new urban jobs, and stated that the government would intensify efforts to attract and use foreign investment.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The targets and policy priorities were presented in the government work report submitted to China's national legislature; the extract does not identify Xi as the author.","limitations":["The supplied extract contains targets and highlights but no executed-budget, implementation, distributional, or end-year outcome evidence.","It does not establish whether the legislature altered or approved the proposals."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-e8db27ca6dce1f9d","SRC-b5cdc2a026f35dda","SRC-fb5d363eb315e07b","SRC-2a4284aa0fb12967"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied material is primarily official statements, policy announcements, institutional reports, and publication metadata; it provides limited independent evidence of implementation, outcomes, correction, or personal responsibility.","Several documents expose only a landing page or attachment link, so their underlying reports were not available in the supplied units.","No score is assigned."]}
